description: A recognisable practice that guidance rejects (URN anti_pattern:<id>; ADR-0052 decision 8, as amended by ADR-0053 decision 30): one file per anti-pattern, anti_patterns/<id>.anti-pattern.yaml. The file is the only form of an anti-pattern; a graph node of the same URN in the pack's graph documents declares it and is the target of a rejects edge from the guidance that rejects it (ADR-0064 decision 12). It carries no relationship fields. Its severity is always written: there is no default (ADR-0053 decision 32). JSON Schema cannot state that the id equals the file stem and that the file sits at anti_patterns/<id>.anti-pattern.yaml: those are the store's stem and placement rule, applied at registration and in validate mode.
